LESSON: SURAH NAAS

Grade: PP2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: QUR’AN
Topic 1.2: Surah Naas

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Surah Naas. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: When do we recite the learner should be able to: and reciting Surah Naas using varied Surah Naas?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recite correctly Surah digital educational materials/resource 2.

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SURAH NAAS
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: PP2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Surah Naas helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: SURAH NAAS
Study Surah Naas like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Recite correctly Surah digital educational materials/resource 2.

What this means
In this part you learn to recite correctly Surah digital educational materials/resource 2.. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recite correctly Surah digital educational materials/resource 2..
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Surah Naas” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recite correctly Surah digital educational materials/resource 2.. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Surah Naas is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Surah Naas” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: recite correctly Surah digital educational materials/resource 2.)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Surah Naas to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: recite correctly Surah digital educational materials/resource 2..
3. Make one local Kenya example of Surah Naas from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Surah Naas: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP2 learner study Surah Naas?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. When do we recite the learner should be able to: and reciting Surah Naas using varied Surah Naas?
2. Which other Surah do lessons) Naas as a form of persons we recite when praying?
3. How many verses are Surah Naas and listen to the recording there in Surah Naas?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Surah Naas means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: recite correctly Surah digital educational materials/resource 2..

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
